answer.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS meeting_event_count
FROM event AS e
JOIN (
  SELECT link_to_event
  FROM attendance
  GROUP BY link_to_event
  HAVING COUNT(link_to_event) > 10
) AS a ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.type = 'Meeting';
